description: This file defines a CatalogFragment class for an Android application that displays a product catalog. It manages UI components such as product list RecyclerView, category filters, search input, sorting options, recent searches, and favorites filter. It handles data loading with pagination, state restoration, user interactions like searching, filtering, and navigating to product details or cart.

classes.name: CatalogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment managing the product catalog UI with filtering, search, sorting, recent searches, and pagination.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, restores state, sets up event listeners, and loads initial data.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Prepares for view destruction, removes callbacks and listeners.

methods.name: setupFavoritesOnlyToggle
methods.description: Sets up the toggle button for favorites-only filtering.

methods.name: updateFavoritesOnlyButton
methods.description: Updates the favorites-only button text and state based on current filter.

methods.name: setupDebouncedSearch
methods.description: Sets up search input with debounce to optimize filtering.

methods.name: setupSortDropdown
methods.description: Configures sort options dropdown and handles selection changes.

methods.name: renderCategoryFilters
methods.description: Dynamically builds category filter chips based on repository data.

methods.name: currentQuerySnapshot
methods.description: Constructs the current catalog query parameters based on selected filters.

methods.name: resetAndLoadFirstPage
methods.description: Clears current data and loads the first page based on current filters.

methods.name: requestNextPageIfNeeded
methods.description: Loads additional data if user scrolls near the end of the list.

methods.name: sortOptionToSpinnerPosition
methods.description: Converts sort enum to spinner position index.

methods.name: sortKeyToSortOption
methods.description: Converts sort key string to enum.

methods.name: persistCatalogPreferences
methods.description: Saves current filter and sort preferences.

methods.name: restoreCatalogPreferences
methods.description: Restores saved filter and sort preferences and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: setupRecentSearchesUi
methods.description: Configures recent search chips and clear button.

methods.name: renderRecentSearches
methods.description: Displays recent search chips in a horizontal layout.

methods.name: applyRecentSearch
methods.description: Sets a recent search query into the search bar and triggers search.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels to actual pixels.
